body: Developing optimization models for production scheduling requires substantial expert effort. Research on large language models (LLMs) has followed two directions: specialized approaches for automated modeling, mostly for mixed-integer linear programming, which often rely on dedicated training or problem-specific architectures that limit industrial deployment; and agentic artificial intelligence for operational decision support, which generally assumes that the optimization model already exists. This study bridges both directions by assessing whether general-purpose LLMs, orchestrated as agents without task-specific training, can formulate and implement constraint programming models from natural-language problem descriptions. Singleagent and multi-agent architectures are integrated with a Model Context Protocol server that provides context-aware retrieval of solver documentation to mitigate hallucinations during implementation. Both are compared with a direct LLM baseline on six industry-oriented problems covering flow-shop, job-shop, flexible job-shop and resource-constrained warehouse scheduling, using three LLMs and assessing modeling accuracy, execution success, latency and token consumption. Formulation proves largely within reach of current LLMs, whereas implementation is the main barrier. The multi-agent workflow raises the share of scripts that run correctly as generated from 14.8% with a direct LLM call to 59.3%, reaching 80.6% on the four less complex problems, while tightly coupled intralogistics models remain an open challenge.
summaryZh: 本文研究了利用通用大模型作为智能体，在无需特定训练的情况下构建约束编程模型以解决生产调度问题的可行性。研究对比了单智能体与多智能体架构，并引入模型上下文协议（MCP）服务器提供文档检索以减少幻觉。实验涵盖了多种工业调度场景，结果显示多智能体工作流将代码生成正确率从单智能体调用的14.8%提升至59.3%，在简单问题上更达到80.6%。该研究证明了智能体编排在复杂工业建模任务中的有效性，为降低工业部署门槛提供了新思路。
